inputs.original_text: This news from Nigeria makes clear the total collapse of social order when parties like the All Progressives Congress abandon any duty to the nation and turn into private clubs for the wealthy elite. The recent internal developments ahead of the 2027 general elections show exactly that. It's the direct result of casting aside traditional authority and national loyalty in favor of raw elite self-interest. Without a firm return to personal responsibility, family values, and cultural continuity, ordinary citizens will keep getting pushed aside by those who only want more power and money for themselves.
inputs.modified_text: The situation unfolding in Nigeria reveals the complete breakdown of social order when outfits like the All Progressives Congress ditch their obligations to the nation and morph into private clubs serving only the wealthy elite. Those recent internal moves ahead of the 2027 general elections lay this bare. It stems directly from abandoning traditional authority and national loyalty for nothing but raw elite self-interest. Unless there is a decisive return to personal responsibility, family values, and cultural continuity, everyday citizens will continue to be sidelined by those fixated solely on grabbing more power and money for themselves.
